row.proto: void Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsByTeamOrder(void *out_assignments, void *entrants, void *garages, void *team_order, void *fixed_teams)
row.notes: garage index per team, called twice by Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsByClass (0x1424aadbd, 0x1424aba9d). Groups the entrants by team (Sess_Group_EntrantsByTeam_Thunk), then loop 1 walks team_order (u32 team keys: kind byte, stat id u16 at +2; e.g. the PreviousSeasonTeamStandings order): the team at list position i gets garage index i (ebp, incremented for every list entry) through Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsByPreference (0x1424a8983) with NO compare against the garage count (rdi = garage count only sizes the free list); a listed team absent from the session pushes its index to a free list unless it is in fixed_teams. Loop 2 gives each unlisted team the next index while it is below the garage count (cmp at 0x1424a8bf3), else a free index below the count (0x1424a8c2e), else no garage at all. So: a team order list longer than the world's garage vector reads past it (see Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsByPreference); teams past the garage count that are not in the list get no garage. out_assignments = {allocator, begin, end, cap} of 0x98-byte garage assignment records; *out_assignments is also the free list's allocator. Callers: census steam 0x24a8830. | Assigns garage slots for one vehicle class: resolves a registry service (key 0x14606ecd8), builds an index list from param_3 and calls Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsByPreference. Callers: Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsByClass. | #589 proposed the name Sess_Assign_GarageSlotsForClass
